_about: Shared sample data: database/seeders/DemoSubmissionSeeder.php seeds it into the real database and resources/js/data/mock.js builds the sample pages from it, so names, codes and statuses match everywhere. 20 registrants (5 attend only, 15 attend + submit) and one paper each for the 15 authors. Days are days before today. Paper steps replay the workflow in order (see DemoSubmissionSeeder::apply()). Every account is key@skdiit.test, password 1234.
